rationale: The short thesis is intact — price is still ~4.4% below VWAP and below the 9-EMA ($8.71), the tape remains risk-off (SPY -0.82%, VIXY +2.89%), and no new headlines have emerged. The drift off $8.40 has come on sharply declining volume (5-6k vs 27-35k on the flush) without reclaiming the 9-EMA, reading as a distribution pause rather than a reversal. With the $8.68 invalidation still sitting above the consolidation shelf and no evidence strong enough to justify paying the 71bps spread to close or flip, holding the working position is the highest-expectancy action.
